skill_name: Compare and contrast the differences between a coral reef and a tropical rainforest.
workflow: Coral reefs and tropical rainforests are two unique ecosystems that are home to a wide array of species. Most notably, coral reefs are marine habitats, while rainforests are terrestrial, though both are highly biodiverse and support a large number of endemic species. Coral reef ecosystems are composed of coral reefs and the organisms and other species that inhabit them.
